newsitem.title: FRANCE: French economist says Dow Jones 20 pct overvalued.
newsitem.headline: French economist says Dow Jones 20 pct overvalued.

text.p: Francois Chevallier, chief economist at bank Credit National-BFCE, said the Dow Jones Industrial index was 20 percent overvalued and a sharp correction lay in store for 1997.

"A sharp correction in 1997 seems inevitable to me because I believe that the Dow Jones is overvalued by some 20 percent and should be around 5,300 points," Chevallier told the La Tribune Desfosses newspaper in an interview.
"Wall Street has not yet taken account of the slow-down in company profits," he added.
